text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Dober runs with all<n>she has, she
realizes how stark the<n>difference in strength
between her<n>and the senior racers is, and this
realization sends her into a<n>depressive episode.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Arima Kinen, Mejiro<n>Dober and I
watch a feature program<n>on this year's classic
racers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, they barely bring up Mejiro<n>Dober.
Instead, all the commentators<n>do is gush about the
achievements of<n>past Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Carrying her promise with Mejiro<n>Bright in her
heart, Mejiro Dober<n>takes her first steps in making
her<n>comeback at the Osaka Hai!
